About Stratum Labs

A senior team building serious software for founders and operators.

Stratum Labs is a senior-only engineering and design studio. We partner with founders and product teams to design, build, and ship SaaS platforms, two-sided marketplaces, AI products, e-commerce, blockchain systems, games and native iOS + Android apps — from discovery to launch and beyond.

Every project is led by the engineers writing the code — not account managers. We work in weekly release cycles, review every pull request, and stay on for a minimum 30 days post-launch to tune against success metrics.

Featured case study — Marketplace

TradeLoop

example.com

A production SaaS marketplace connecting service seekers with verified providers — intelligent job routing, a credit-based lead economy, Stripe-backed credit packs, real-time chat, and a full admin console with audit logging.

  • Two-sided marketplace
  • Real-time
  • Credit economy
Problem
Directory sites force seekers to cold-call strangers. Lead-gen platforms sell the same lead to five providers in a race to the bottom. Neither side gets accountability, transparent pricing, or dispute recourse.
Outcome
A request-first, claim-based marketplace where complexity-tiered credits replace blind lead-selling, price confirmation prevents bait-and-switch, and an immutable audit log backs every moderation action.

Frequently asked

Questions we get before every kickoff.

Do not see yours? The contact form has an open message field — send it and we will reply within one business day.

How do you price projects?

Fixed-price for well-scoped phases, monthly retainer for ongoing work. We quote after discovery, never before — a number given without understanding the problem is a number that gets revised. Most engagements start between $25k and $100k.

What is a typical project timeline?

An MVP is usually 8–14 weeks from kickoff to production. A full platform with billing, admin tooling and mobile apps runs 4–6 months. You see a working build in staging every week from week three onward.

Who actually writes the code?

The senior engineers you meet on the first call. No handoff to a junior bench, no offshore subcontracting, no account manager between you and the team. The person who designs the data model is the person who ships it.

Do we own the code and IP?

Yes — fully, from day one. Code lives in your repository under your organisation, with every commit attributed. Our contract assigns all IP to you on payment, and there is no licensing tail or vendor lock-in.

Can you work with our existing team or codebase?

Often. We start with a short technical audit, agree on conventions and review standards, and then work as part of your process — your board, your branching model, your release cadence. We will say so plainly if a rewrite is cheaper than a rescue.

What happens after launch?

A minimum 30-day post-launch window is included in every engagement: we fix, tune and measure against the original success metrics. After that, most clients continue on a monthly retainer, and some take the code fully in-house with a handover walkthrough.
